import json, re, pathlib

assert sub['conclusion'] == schema['properties']['conclusion']['const']
assert sub['scope'] == schema['properties']['scope']['const']
assert sub['completeness'] == schema['properties']['completeness']['const']

assert sub['limitations'] == schema['properties']['limitations']['const']

assert sub['evidence'][0]['path'] == 'evidence/answer.txt'
assert re.match(r'"'^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'"', sub['evidence'][0]['sha256'])

    assert pat.match(sub['result'][k]), k
for item in sub['result']['circle_coefficients'] + sub['result']['distance_coefficients']:
    assert pat.match(item), item
print('validation ok')
PY"
